title: Persistent LSD records and well source visibility
notes: Searching the same LSD now reopens and updates the existing saved record instead of creating duplicate history entries.
Saved notes, disposal selection, surface well information, first searched time, last searched time, and search count stay attached to the LSD.
Existing duplicate LSD history entries are merged automatically on load while preserving saved information.
The Wells panel now clearly shows whether results came from live AER OneStop or the offline August 2026 ST37 fallback.
Online well searches query the AER OneStop Well Licences layer first.
